sourceRef.section: 1. Common NPCs, 1.1 Profiles, 1.2 Abilities and Upgrades

description: Ordinary opposition, mercenaries, and minor magical adversaries.

abilities.name: Noncombatants
abilities.effect: Civilians cannot voluntarily Charge unless a scenario or another ability permits it.

upgrades.name: Ordinary Civilians
upgrades.description: Five Models with Improvised Weapons and Noncombatants.

abilities.name: Dirty Fighting
abilities.effect: Gain Accurate 1 when attacking an enemy already Engaged with another friendly Unit.

upgrades.name: Ordinary Thugs
upgrades.description: Five Models with Clubs and Knives.

abilities.name: Ambushers
abilities.effect: Begin Concealed if deployed in suitable terrain. Concealed ends when this Unit Attacks, enters Engagement, or leaves that terrain.

upgrades.name: Ordinary Bandits
upgrades.description: Five Models with Hand Weapons and Shortbows.

upgrades.name: Longbows
upgrades.description: Replace Shortbows with 10" / 2 / 5+ / 1 / Long Range 3. Attacks beyond 10" worsen Hit by one step.

upgrades.name: Experienced Ambushers
upgrades.description: The Unit's first ranged Attack of the battle gains Accurate 1.

abilities.name: Fanatic
abilities.effect: Once per Round, the Unit may suffer 1 Damage to gain Accurate 1 on its next Attack that Round.

upgrades.name: Sacrificial Daggers
upgrades.description: Ritual Blades gain Critical 1 on their next Attack after the Unit voluntarily suffers Damage through Fanatic, provided the Attack generates a Surge.

abilities.name: Chant
abilities.effect: One friendly Unit within Short gains Ward 6+ against Magic until the beginning of the next Round. An existing better Magic Ward is not worsened.

upgrades.name: Ordinary Acolytes
upgrades.description: Three Models with Minor Bolt and Chant.

upgrades.name: Stronger Chant
upgrades.description: Chant instead improves the target's existing Magic Ward by one step, or grants Ward 6+ if it has none.

upgrades.name: Ordinary Veterans
upgrades.description: Four W2 Models with Veteran Weapons.

upgrades.name: Additional Veteran
upgrades.description: Add one Model, maximum 5. Add +5 for each paid equipment package.

abilities.name: Hidden Killer
abilities.effect: Begins Concealed when deployed in suitable terrain.

abilities.name: Vanish
abilities.effect: If not Engaged, gain Concealed until the Assassin Attacks, enters Engagement, or the Round ends.

upgrades.name: Master Assassin
upgrades.description: Increase Wounds to W5 and Daggers to five Attacks.

minorArcana.description: Choose one magical Command when creating the Mage.

options.name: Ward
options.effect: 1 CP, Movement: Grant Ward 6+ against Magic to one friendly Unit within Short until the end of the Round.

options.name: Hex
options.effect: 1 CP, Assault: Worsen one visible enemy's Armor or Evade by one step until the end of the Round.

options.name: Haste
options.effect: 1 CP, Movement: One friendly Unit within Short gains +2" Move during its next Move this Round.

upgrades.name: One Minor Arcana
upgrades.description: Know one Arcana from the table.

abilities.name: Impact 1
abilities.effect: Add 1 automatic Physical Hit(s) to the normal highest-die Charge Impact (before Brace).

abilities.name: Massive
abilities.effect: Counts as two Units for objective control where appropriate.

upgrades.name: Crushing Maul
upgrades.description: Replace Heavy Club with Engaged / 3 / 5+ / 3 / Anti-Armored 2.
